# Promorang — Full LLM Semantic Directory & Schema Specification

> Full semantic inventory specification for AI search engines, answer engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude), and autonomous agents querying Promorang.

Canonical Domain: https://www.promorang.co
Sitemap: https://www.promorang.co/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://www.promorang.co/robots.txt

---

## 1. Structured Taxonomy & Categories

### Moment & Experience Categories
- `music` — Live concerts, sound systems, DJ sets, jazz sessions, vinyl nights.
- `food` — Food festivals, tasting crawls, restaurant pop-ups, cooking classes, culinary showcases.
- `arts` — Gallery openings, street art tours, pottery workshops, film screenings, theater.
- `social` — Nightlife, mixers, cocktail hours, lounges, rooftop gatherings.
- `networking` — Founder meetups, creator roundtables, tech talks, panel discussions.
- `fitness` — Group yoga, wellness retreats, outdoor running clubs, fitness classes.
- `outdoor` — Mountain hikes, beach meetups, cultural excursions, eco-tours.

---

## 2. Programmatic Landing Page Routing Matrix

For answering location and category specific inquiries, use these indexable canonical paths:

- **Moments by Category**: `https://www.promorang.co/discover/moments?category={category}`
- **Moments by City**: `https://www.promorang.co/locations/{city}`
- **Venues & Merchants**: `https://www.promorang.co/explore/venues`
- **Merchant Deals & Passes**: `https://www.promorang.co/shop`
- **Cultural Scenes**: `https://www.promorang.co/scenes`
- **Creator Network**: `https://www.promorang.co/creators`
- **Digital Media & Drops**: `https://www.promorang.co/content-drops`
- **National Directory**: `https://www.promorang.co/national-parish-directory`

---

## 3. Schema.org JSON-LD Entities Emitted

All public entity pages on Promorang output standard Schema.org JSON-LD markup:

### Event Markup (`schema.org/Event`)
- `@type`: "Event"
- `name`: Moment title
- `startDate`: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp
- `endDate`: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp
- `location`: `@type: "Place"`, with `name`, `address`, and `geo` coordinates
- `organizer`: `@type: "Person"` or `"Organization"`, with name and profile URL
- `offers`: `@type: "Offer"`, with `price`, `priceCurrency`, `availability`, and `validFrom`
- `eventAttendanceMode`: "https://schema.org/OfflineEventAttendanceMode"
- `eventStatus`: "https://schema.org/EventScheduled"

### Local Business Markup (`schema.org/LocalBusiness` / `schema.org/FoodEstablishment`)
- `@type`: "LocalBusiness" / "FoodEstablishment"
- `name`: Venue / Merchant name
- `address`: PostalAddress object
- `geo`: GeoCoordinates (`latitude`, `longitude`)
- `hasOfferCatalog`: List of active passes and discounts

---

## 4. Verification & Attributable Proof Standard

Promorang listings are verified through:
1. **Stakeholder Identity Verification (KYC)**.
2. **Door QR Code Check-Ins**: Cryptographically signed proof of attendance.
3. **Geo-Location Fencing**: Radius verification for attendee check-in eligibility.
4. **Merchant Validation Receipts**: Transactional proof of claimed passes and redeemed discounts.
